items.label: Broadcom AI chip revenue, one quarter

footnote: Source: Nvidia (Aug 2026), Broadcom and Micron (Sep 2026), TSMC (Jul 2026). Nvidia fiscal quarters, FY27Q2 ended July 2026
notes: What the clouds spend becomes supplier revenue first. Nvidia's data center revenue was $89.0bn in the second quarter of fiscal 2027, to July 2026, up 117%, with a GAAP gross margin of 75%. It guided total revenue to $108bn for the next quarter, excluding China data center compute. Hyperscalers bought $48.7bn of it, and AI clouds, industrial and enterprise customers $40.3bn, the faster-growing part. Broadcom's AI semiconductor revenue was $16.7bn in the quarter, up 221%, guided to $21.7bn next. Micron's quarterly revenue was $54.2bn, up 379%, and most of its 2027 HBM capacity is already contracted. TSMC raised its 2026 capex budget from $52bn to $56bn to $60bn to $64bn. Dearer memory also pushes up the clouds' own bills: about $25bn of Microsoft's roughly $190bn plan for 2026 came from component prices, and Amazon raised its guide from about $200bn to about $220bn because of memory costs. On valuation, Nvidia trades at about 16.5 times forward earnings, its lowest since January 2015 (Reuters, citing LSEG).
